capabilities: Route the current note to its first rule-matched folder
Preview a note's destination with a dry run before moving
Sweep every matching note in the Inbox folder in one pass
Build destination paths from templates like {{frontmatter:project}}
Auto-route newly created notes after their metadata is indexed (Pro)
extras: Freemium: free tier caps 5 active rules and 25 moves per sweep; Pro ($12 one-time, offline Ed25519 license verification) unlocks unlimited rules, sweeps, and auto-route. Manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice.
problem: Obsidian leaves filing to manual drag-and-drop, so new notes pile up in an Inbox folder instead of moving to their proper home.

requires.name: Vault Router Pro ($12 one-time license via Buy Me a Coffee)

summary: Rule-based file mover that routes notes to folders matched by title, path, tags, or frontmatter, with a dry-run preview and an Inbox sweep.
